request.text: [earnest] Then teach us your glass, and they will never drink again.

text: Then teach us your glass, and they will never drink again.

voice.description: A young queen in her mid-twenties: a clear, warm mezzo-soprano voice with quiet authority, compassionate yet fierce and certain, a hint of pride. Regal but not cold, youthful and alive, never breathy. She speaks English with a soft, neutral accent, close to the microphone in a quiet room, performing a character in a fantasy game.
